entities.name: Totentanz
entities.description: Human warlock minstrel from Eldraine who led Edgewall's citizens into the sewers for Lord Skitter.

entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: Rat king beneath Edgewall who recruited Totentanz.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: Village on Eldraine whose sewers are overrun by rats.

entities.name: Pied Piper of Hamelin
entities.description: Folk figure on whom Totentanz is based.

events.summary: Totentanz falls into the sewers beneath Edgewall and is led by rats to Lord Skitter.
events.quote: he fell into the sewers beneath and was led by the rats to Lord Skitter.

events.summary: Skitter promises wicked powers in exchange for luring townsfolk to become food; Totentanz agrees and receives a magic pipe.
events.quote: Skitter gifted him a magic pipe that could enthrall listeners.

events.summary: Totentanz leads droves of citizens into the undercity and rats swarm the city.
events.quote: Totentanz led droves of hapless Edgewall citizens into the undercity with his music.

events.summary: The citizens steal the pipe and twist its magic on Skitter and Totentanz, who are devoured by the rats.
events.quote: causing them to be devoured by their rat horde

relations.note: He agreed to join the rat king.
relations.quote: When the bard agreed to join the rat king

relations.note: Totentanz is based on this figure.
relations.quote: Totentanz is based on the Pied Piper of Hamelin .
